name: innoveta-method
description: Innoveta's project-records methodology for AI-maintained codebases: tiered docs (CLAUDE.md + PROJECT_STATUS / ROADMAP / HISTORY), cold-start session handoffs, a parallel-safe ideas capture/triage workflow, and the surface review (goal-first screen review, layout lint and landing gate), feature scoping told as real examples (the scope skill and the examples-first standard), and the walkthrough (Ben reviews what was built on seeded examples; findings sliced and ruled).
